sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact executor is acquired before try and every exit executes finally shutdownNow plus awaitTermination10s with failing postcondition assertion. Each of64 Futures joins5s. Ownership remains local to whole JUnit Test; implicit close may wait unbounded and is not substituted for termination evidence.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact site belongs to whole pure JUnit Test, not managed J2EE webapp. Eight locally owned workers run64 fixed byte/globallookup/file-order assertions, Futures5s and finallyshutdownNow/await10s bound cleanup. No process/native/DB/Root/service or authorization operation.
